description: 臺灣橋頭地方檢察署109年度會計報告 [roads, bridges and tunnels] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺灣橋頭地方檢察署. 會計年度、月份、款、項、目、節、預算年度、預算科目編號、預算科目名稱、細目編號、細目名稱、原預算數、追加減數、截至本月止累計分配數1、本月實現數、截至本月止累計實現數2、應收收入數3、分配數預算餘額4、分支計畫編號、分支計畫名稱、用途別編號、用途別名稱、第一預備金、第二預備金、經費流用數、預算調整數、應付數、已分配尚未執行數、備註... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 臺灣橋頭地方檢察署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2023-07-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
